        21       Duane, to explain his vote.

        22                  SENATOR DUANE:    Thank you,

        23       Mr. President.

        24                  I'm going to vote against this bill

        25       because one of the provisions allows for the



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         1706



         1       suspension of a car's registration due to

         2       unpaid toll collections.

         3                  You know, many New Yorkers are

         4       living in one-car families.  And particularly

         5       with the increased price of gasoline, I think

         6       it's going to become even more prevalent as

         7       time goes on.  But even today, many

         8       New Yorkers live in a one-car family.  And if

         9       we take away the registration for a car, it

        10       means that family members may not be able to

        11       go to work or a doctor's appointment or to

        12       bring a child to daycare.

        13                  And, you know, I don't care if we

        14       charge fines for not paying tolls.  But the

        15       harshness of taking away a registration and

        16       the potentially devastating economic impact

        17       that could have on an entire family I think is

        18       too harsh.

        19                  So I'm going to be voting no on

        20       this bill, with the hope that at least the

        21       provision of the removal of the registration

        22       will be taken away, and then I could in good

        23       conscience vote for it.  But to make it

        24       impossible for a family to use a car for

        25       health reasons or for a job I think is just



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       not appropriate.

         2                  So I'll be voting no, and I do urge

         3       my colleagues also to vote no.

         4                  Thank you, Mr. President.
